body:
Put the personas in the investigate, work, discuss and review briefs. The vision is left out of review briefs (D-91 item 4), but personas are wanted there: a review also judges whether the change serves them.

- Each persona is shown by name with its non-empty Objectives, Tools, Concerns and Other.
- The section is capped (propose a size like the vision's 1000 characters); personas past the cap are named and marked as cut, never silently dropped.
- No section when there are no personas.
- Strategy runs: decide in the task whether they see personas in full; they can already read the plan.
- Document in specs/15-board-api.md and DECISIONS.md.

Left out: choosing which persona applies to a task.
title: personas: agent briefs carry them
